title: 870 Western Lake Drive | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Spacious WaterColor Escape with Private Pool, Bikes & Golf Cart Near Seaside- 870 Western Lake Drive by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 870 Western Lake Drive by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor Phase 1 (Bordering Seaside Village Center) Address: 870 Western Lake Drive, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: This beautifully updated WaterColor retreat offers the ultimate 30A lifestyle, complete with a private heated pool and golf cart all perfectly situated between the vibrant town centers of WaterColor and Seaside. Located at 870 Western Lake Drive, this home places you just a short walk or quick ride from some of the area’s most sought-after dining, shopping, and beach access points. Thoughtfully designed for both comfort and connection, 870 Western Lake Drive features a bright, open-concept layout ideal for gathering with family and friends. With well-appointed suites on both the first and second floors, it offers both privacy and flexibility for multiple guests. The second level serves as the heart of the home, featuring a spacious living area that flows seamlessly into a gourmet kitchen complete with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and an inviting dining space. The primary suite is also located upstairs and offers a king-sized bed along with a private en suite bath. After a day at the beach or exploring nearby Seaside, unwind in your private heated pool, or enjoy the coastal breeze from the covered second-floor porch, perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings. For added convenience and fun, the home includes four adult bikes and a golf cart, making it easy to explore everything 30A has to offer. This home truly delivers the best of both worlds (walkability, comfort, and premium amenities) all in one exceptional WaterColor location. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Located in Watercolor Phase One - Golf Cart - *Private Heated Pool - Near the WaterColor Beach Club and 1 Block from Seaside Village - 4 Adult Bikes - 2 Dedicated Parking Spots - Walking Distance to the Beach, Shopping, Dining, Entertainment Etc. *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. WaterColor Community Highlights: - Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. - WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. - A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community - Bike Community - Award-Winning Tennis Facilities - Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining - Nearby State Parks and Preserves - 4 Swimming Pools Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 9 3 Bedrooms / 3 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom 2: Bunk Room: Two Twin/Twin Bunks, One Trundle, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Laundry Room Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore!
